title: [Audit] 👤 Identity 360
description: One identity’s complete footprint — pick someone in Identity in the control bar and every panel becomes their story.

config.content:
### Everything one person did, on one page

Use it to check whether their activity is normal, see what they changed and read, and gather evidence for a review or investigation. Raw records: [All audit events](/app/discover#/view/cloud-audit-search-all-events), [Raw signal feed](/app/discover#/view/cloud-audit-search-raw-signal-feed).

**How to use it:** pick someone in the Identity control, or click a Principal id in a table; with nobody selected, the page covers everyone. ① *Is this normal?* always looks at the last 7 days in UTC, ② *What they did* follows the time picker, and ③ *Evidence* ends in the raw records. Table times are in your time zone.

- Pick an Identity type first to shorten the Identity list. A person’s API keys are identities of their own, so their traffic never counts under the person.
- The ① panels read a fixed 7 days with no noise gate, so they will not match the Events tile or the time picker.
- Baseline: the band is their usual range for each hour; with under three days of history no band is drawn.
- The Risk tile and Every scoring action count whole minutes only, so they can stop up to a minute short of the panels around them.
- Session timeline: click a bar to pin a session (Elasticsearch panels then read empty); API-only identities have no sessions.
- Identities read as in the Identity dropdown, a Cloud API key shortened to “_4KEO… · Cloud API key”. The dropdowns apply to this page only; the links above do not carry them.

config.title: Who this is — by identity and principal id · top 5 at most
config.description: The identities behind the selection, busiest first, named as in the Identity dropdown, with the Principal id each ran as. Click a Principal id to pin it across the suite. Unattributed requests count in Events but have no row.

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND ((?project == "" OR ?project == "Any") OR project.name == ?project) AND ((?identity == "" OR ?identity == "Any") OR user.email == ?identity OR api_key.name == ?identity OR user.name == ?identity OR user.name == REPLACE(REPLACE(?identity, " · Cloud API key$", ""), "^Unnamed key of ", "") OR (?identity == "(unattributed)" AND user.name IS NULL)) AND ((?identity_kind == "" OR ?identity_kind == "Any") OR (?identity_kind == "Person" AND user.email IS NOT NULL) OR (?identity_kind == "Elasticsearch API key" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NOT NULL) OR (?identity_kind == "Elasticsearch API key (name not recorded)" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_es_api_key") OR (?identity_kind == "Cloud API key" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_cloud_api_key") OR (?identity_kind == "Service account" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_service_account") OR (?identity_kind == "Failed sign-in" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) OR (?identity_kind == "Unattributed" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) AND user.name IS NULL) OR (?identity_kind == "Other" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) AND user.name IS NOT NULL)) AND ((?identity == "" OR ?identity == "Any") OR user.email == ?identity OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name == ?identity) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_cloud_api_key" AND ENDS_WITH(?identity, " · Cloud API key") AND user.name == REPLACE(?identity, " · Cloud API key$", "")) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_es_api_key" AND STARTS_WITH(?identity, "Unnamed key of ") AND user.name == REPLACE(?identity, "^Unnamed key of ", "")) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key")) AND user.name == ?identity) OR (?identity == "(unattributed)" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key")) AND user.name IS NULL)) AND ((?client_ip == "" OR ?client_ip == "Any") OR client.ip == TO_IP(CASE((?client_ip == "" OR ?client_ip == "Any"), null, ?client_ip))) | STATS events = COUNT(*) BY user.email, api_key.name, user.domain, user.name | WHERE user.email IS NOT NULL OR NOT STARTS_WITH(user.name, "<") | EVAL actor = CASE(user.email IS NOT NULL, user.email, api_key.name IS NOT NULL, api_key.name, user.domain == "_cloud_api_key", CONCAT(user.name, " · Cloud API key"), user.domain == "_es_api_key", CONCAT("Unnamed key of ", user.name), user.name IS NOT NULL, user.name, "(unattributed)") | STATS events = SUM(events) BY actor, user.name | SORT events DESC, actor, user.name | LIMIT 5 | EVAL actor = REPLACE(REPLACE(actor, "^([-_A-Za-z0-9]{5})[-_A-Za-z0-9]{15} · Cloud API key$", "$1… · Cloud API key"), "^Unnamed key of ([-_A-Za-z0-9]{5})[-_A-Za-z0-9]{15}$", "Unnamed key of $1…")

config.description: Total risk for the selection (weight × events for everything that scored), how many scoring actions, and the highest weight; 50 is a security configuration change. Routine activity scores zero. Every scoring action below lists the receipts.

config.description: How widely this selection reaches into Elasticsearch: index families named in their requests, and how many distinct indices those families hold. Dated and backing indices fold into one family, so thirty days of a daily index is one.
